mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDPC1 acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in INDPRO exceeds 4%, it signals a supply-side overheating that will lead to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following YoY INDPRO > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp 0.5 percentage point increase in UNRATE over the past 3 months signals a weakening labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in RSAFS exceeds 10%, it signals a consumer spending boom that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY RSAFS growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST declines by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a housing market slowdown that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following YoY HOUST decline > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth slows by more than 1% year-over-year, it signals a weakening labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following YoY PAYEMS growth slowing by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3% year-over-year, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will drive the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following YoY CPIAUCSL growth > 3%.
